Faka isicelo sevoti ekhethekileyo ngexesha lezicelo le-IEC, kwi-intanethi ku-elections.org.za okanye kwi-ofisi ye-IEC yasekuhlaleni. Iivoti ezikhethekileyo zifakwa kwiintsuku ezingaphambi komhla wonyulo, ekhaya okanye kwisikhululo sakho.
Kunyulo lwesizwe kuphela. Ukuba ubhalisile, yazisa i-IEC kwi-intanethi (ifomu VEC10) phambi komhla wokugqibela, uze uvote kwi-ofisi yozakuzo yoMzantsi Afrika.

Ewe. Ukuba unokhubazeko okanye awukwazi ukufunda, umntu omkhethayo oneminyaka eli-18 nangaphezulu, okanye igosa elongameleyo, linokukunceda. Abavoti abangaboniyo kakuhle banokucela i-Universal Ballot Template.

Thumela inombolo yesazisi nge-SMS ku-32810 (R1 nge-SMS nganye), ucofe *120*432#, okanye usebenzise My Registration Details ku-elections.org.za. Ungajonga iinkcukacha zakho ze-app phantsi kokuthi Jonga ubhaliso lwam kwiKhaya.

Phinda ubhalise kwidilesi yakho entsha ukuze ube kuluhlu olufanelekileyo lwabavoti. Kwenze kwi-intanethi ku-elections.org.za okanye kwi-ofisi ye-IEC yasekuhlaleni phambi kokuba uluhlu luvalwe, nto leyo eyenzeka xa unyulo lubhengezwa.
Ewe, ukuba ufumana isatifikethi sesazisi sethutyana kwiMicimbi yezeKhaya phambi kosuku lokuvota kwaye ukuluhlu lwabavoti. Faka isicelo kwangethuba, ii-ofisi zixakekile kufutshane nonyulo.
Hayi. Amaphepha akho agcinwa ngethokheni yokuvota esetyenziswa kanye, hayi igama lakho okanye inombolo yesazisi. Iirisithi ziqinisekisa ukuba iphepha lirekhodiwe, hayi iqela olikhethileyo.

Igama lakho, inombolo yesazisi, iifoto zesazisi, umzobo wobuso, idilesi nenombolo yeselfowuni, zisetyenziswa kuphela ukukubhalisa nokuqinisekisa ukuba nguwe. Phantsi kwe-POPIA ungacela ukubona okanye ukulungisa olu lwazi ngokuthi Xela ingxaki.

Ubuso bakho buguqulwa bube ngumzobo wamanani kwifowuni yakho. Kugcinwa loo mzobo kuphela, kwaye usetyenziselwa kuphela ukuqinisekisa ukuba nguwe xa ungena naphambi kokuba ivoti yakho ifakwe. Awunxulunyaniswa nokhetho lwakho.
